patch_description: The blended surrogate `score()` (0.6·min + 0.4·mean-of-smallest-5) optimizes a different quantity than the graded metric, which is the pure minimum triangle area. Near a plateau, surrogate-optimal points can be exact-poor. Two targeted changes: (1) after the surrogate `fine_polish`, run a final coordinate hill-climb directly on `true_score` so the last refinement pushes the actual graded objective; (2) since the true polish may move points, re-verify with `true_score` and accept on any non-negative improvement (ties accepted to allow lateral exploration of flat directions that may later yield gains via diagonal moves). This is cheap (286 triangles vectorized) and deterministic, directly targeting min_area_normalized rather than the proxy.
